The Student Internship Program, a unique learning opportunity aims to provide the Interns exposure to the functioning of the CAG of India and the Indian Audit & Accounts Department.

rawCardText: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card

The scheme aims to promote soil test-based nutrient management by providing Soil Health Cards containing soil analysis results and fertilizer recommendations to farmers across India.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: National Talent Scholarship Undergraduate
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
The scholarship aims to support meritorious students by providing financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month during their undergraduate studies.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: National Food Security Mission NFSM
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

National Food Security Mission was launched in 2007-08 to increase the production of rice, wheat and pulses. Later, coarse cereals, nutri cereals, commercial crops (sugarcane, jute, and cotton) were also added to the mission.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Kisan Credit Card
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme was introduced in 1998 for issue of Kisan Credit Cards to farmers on the basis of their holdings for uniform adoption by the banks so that farmers may use them to readily purchase agriculture inputs and draw cash for their production needs.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Krishonnati Yojana - Sub Mission On Seed And Planting Material (SMSP)
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP) aims to increase the production of certified / quality seed, increase SRR, upgrade the quality of farm-saved seeds, strengthen the seed multiplication chain, promote new technologies and methodologies in seed production, processing, testing, etc.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The “Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme (CPIS)” is being implemented by the Coconut Development Board, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India with the objective of insuring coconut palms against natural calamities, climatic risks, pests, diseases, and other perils.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: ICAR - Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes Candidates
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme aims to provide Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes candidates for study at Bachelor Degree programme in various branches of Agriculture, viz. B.Sc. (Agri.), B.V.Sc., B.Sc. (Agril. Engg.), B.Sc. (Home Science), B.F.Sc., B.Sc. (Forestry) etc.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

A welfare scheme by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare was launched in 2002. AC&ABC aims at agricultural development, supplementing the efforts of public extension by providing extension and other services to farmers either on a payment basis or free of cost as per the business model.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: National Mission on Natural Farming
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme aims to promote natural farming practices through capacity building, training, certification, and financial assistance for on-farm input production infrastructure, thereby reducing cultivation costs and increasing farmers' income.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: NDRI Institute Scholarship For M.Sc. And Ph.d
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible Indian students admitted to M.Sc. (Dairying) and Ph.D. (Dairying) programmes at NDRI through monthly scholarships during the prescribed period of study.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Indian Agricultural Research Institute - Scholarship
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
The Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) Junior and Senior Scholarship shall be awarded to M.Sc. and Ph.D. students admitted under General Open Competition Scheme.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme “Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India on 1st July 2015. The scheme mainly focuses on water use efficiency at farm level through Micro Irrigation.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: National Agriculture Insurance Scheme
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The National Agriculture Insurance Scheme (NAIS) was introduced by the Government of India to provide comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers against crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
The scheme aims to provide old-age social security through a minimum assured monthly pension of ₹ 3,000/- to Small and Marginal Farmers after attaining the age of 60 years.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: ICAR Senior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

ICAR awards a certain number of Senior Research Fellowships for Ph.D. in an Agricultural University (AU), in different disciplines of agriculture and allied sciences. This is done to encourage talented students to undertake higher agricultural education.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: MANAGE Internship Programme
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

MANAGE Internship Programme is open to students from the disciplines of Extension Education, Economics, Sociology, Psychology, MSW, Journalism, Communication, and Environmental Science. The internships are open year-round, and the duration ranges from 3 months upto 6 months.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: ICAR Junior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

ICAR awards a certain number of Junior Research Fellowships for Postgraduate Studies (course and research work) leading to a Master’s degree, in different disciplines of agriculture and allied sciences. This is done to encourage talented students to undertake higher agricultural education.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme aims to provide easy and affordable access to soil testing facilities at the village level and support rural youth through financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- for establishing Village Level Soil Testing Labs.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Agricultural Extension
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

Extension Division endeavours towards successful implementation of Agricultural Extension activities. Through its various programmes, schemes and activities, Extension Division helps farmers to get information regarding scientific research and new knowledge in agricultural practices.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: CIFE - Institutional Fellowship
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

From the year 2010 onwards, the division is offering Masters and PhD in two disciplines namely Fish Nutrition and Feed Technology and Fish physiology and Biochemistry with an objective of moulding professionals with fundamental and advanced knowledge and expertise.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Kera Suraksha Insurance Scheme
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The ‘Kera Suraksha Insurance Scheme’ is a comprehensive Group Personal Accident Insurance Scheme, implemented by Coconut Development Board in association with Public Insurance companies for Coconut Tree Climbers/Neera Technicians/Coconut Harvesters.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: National Talent Scholarship Postgraduate
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

Merit-based support through the National Talent Scholarship to the post-graduate students seeking admission in agricultural universities in a state other than the state of their domicile through ICAR All India Entrance Examination (AIEE).

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Netaji Subhas - ICAR International Fellowship
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme aims to develop competent human resources in agriculture and allied sciences through international doctoral education and research opportunities, while providing fellowship support, travel assistance, and exposure to world-class institutions.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Student READY (Rural Entrepreneurship Awareness Development Yojana)
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The Student READY (Rural Entrepreneurship Awareness Development Yojana) program aims to provide rural entrepreneurship awareness, and practical experience in a real-life situation in rural agriculture, and create awareness to undergraduate students about practical agriculture and allied sciences.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana was launched in 2016 with the aim to support farmers by providing an affordable comprehensive risk cover for crops.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Merit·cum·Means Scholarships For Under Graduate Studies In Various Branches Of Agriculture And Animal Science Subjects
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme of "Merit·cum·Means Scholarships For Under Graduate Studies In Various Branches Of Agriculture And Animal Science Subjects" was introduced by ICAR with a view to attracting meritorious undergraduate students to prosecute their studies up to graduation level.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: SAHAKAR MITRA: NCDC’s Scheme on Internship Programme
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
The programme aims at providing an opportunity to professional graduates to get experience in areas of functioning of NCDC and related aspects of cooperatives.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: National Agriculture Market
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

Launched on 14th April 2016, e-NAM is a pan-India electronic trading platform that links existing mandis to create a unified online market for agricultural commodities, promoting “One Nation One Market” and enabling transparent, efficient, and nationwide agri-trade.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: ICAR Emeritus Scientist Scheme
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme aims to utilize the expertise of outstanding superannuated scientists of the National Agricultural Research System by supporting nationally important research, teaching, human resource development, and extension activities through honorarium and research grants.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: ICAR Emeritus Professor
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
The ICAR floated the Scheme of Emeritus Professor in order to provide an opportunity to the superannuated teachers/ Scientists of universities, colleges and institutions under ICAR-AU System.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Rainfed Area Development
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

Rainfed Area Development (RAD) scheme was launched in 2014-15 to mainstream development of rainfed areas in a sustainable manner. It adopts an area-based approach, focuses on Integrated Farming System (IFS) for enhancing productivity and minimizing risks associated with climatic variability.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

With a view to provide income support to all landholding farmers’ families in the country, having cultivable land, the Central Government has implemented a Central Sector Scheme, namely, “Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)”.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY), launched in 2015, is an extended component of Soil Health Management (SHM) under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS), National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA).

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The revitalized and farmers’ income enhancing centric sub-scheme Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure (AMI) of Integrated Scheme for Agricultural Marketing (ISAM) is meant for holistic development of agricultural value chain critically focusing each linkage of post-harvest value chain.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: IVRI Institute Scholarship For M.V.Sc. And Ph.D.
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The Indian Veterinary Research Institute will award scholarships to MVSc and PhD students who need financial assistance.his provision will be utilized to assist as many students as possible who have good academic record and who are making diligent efforts to pursue higher education.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Mission on Integrated Development of Horticulture- NHM and HMNEH
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The scheme aims to promote the holistic growth of the horticulture sector through production enhancement, productivity improvement, post-harvest management, processing, marketing support, skill development, and infrastructure creation for horticulture crops while augmenting farmers’ income.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Integrated Scheme on Agriculture Cooperation
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The Integrated Scheme on Agriculture Cooperation (ISAC) is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. It is being implemented through the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC).

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: National Bamboo Mission
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

Restructured National Bamboo Mission was launched during 2018-19 as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) after the historical amendment of the Indian Forest Act during 2017 to exclude bamboo out from definition of tree.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: Sub-mission On Agriculture Mechanization
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
The Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization was launched in 2014-15 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
rawCardText: National Mission on Edible Oils- Oil Palm
Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

The Mission was launched with the aim to enhance the edible oilseeds production and oils availability in the country by harnessing Oil Palm area expansion, increasing CPO production and to reduce import burden on edible oils.
Prime Minister's Award for Yoga
Ministry Of Ayush
The purpose of the Award is to recognize and felicitate individual(s)/ organization(s) who have made a significant impact on society for a sustained period by way of promotion and development of Yoga
National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
Ministry Of Ayush

The objective of the award is to motivate vaidyas and Ayurveda experts to adopt and showcase best practices in Ayurveda, promoting high standards of excellence. The award also aims to encourage innovation and outstanding performance in the field through healthy competition.

Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Support for Development of Standards and Accreditation/Certification of Ayush Products and Materials in Collaboration With BIS, QCI and Other Relevant Scientific Institutions and Industrial R&D Centres
Ministry Of Ayush

The scheme-component aims to support organizations and institutions in developing standards and accreditation frameworks for Ayush products and materials to ensure quality, safety, and scientific validation.
Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Strengthening and Up-Gradation of Ayush Pharmacies and Drug Testing Laboratories to Achieve Higher Standards
Ministry Of Ayush
The scheme-component aims to strengthen and upgrade ASU&H pharmacies and drug testing laboratories to improve quality control and manufacturing standards of Ayush drugs.
Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine
Ministry Of Ayush
The scheme-component aims to promote AYUSH interventions for the treatment and rehabilitation of sports injuries and to enhance health and fitness among sports persons.

Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Strengthening of Central and State Regulatory Frameworks Including Technical Human Resource and Capacity Building Programs for Ayush Drugs
Ministry Of Ayush

The scheme component aims to strengthen the regulatory framework for Ayush drugs at the Central and State/UT levels by enhancing technical manpower, capacity building, quality control systems, and regulatory infrastructure.
Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH and Public Health
Ministry Of Ayush
The scheme-component aims to promote AYUSH-based interventions to improve community health outcomes by supporting preventive, promotive, curative, and rehabilitative healthcare services.
Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Pharmacovigilance of ASU&H Drugs Including Surveillance of Misleading Advertisements
Ministry Of Ayush

The scheme-component aims to establish a robust safety monitoring and surveillance system for Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani and Homoeopathy (ASU&H) drugs and to monitor misleading advertisements related to Ayush medicines.
Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana
Ministry Of Ayush
The scheme aims to enhance India's manufacturing capabilities and exports of traditional medicines and health promotion products under the initiative of Atmanirbhar Bharat.
Ayurswasthya Yojana: Up-gradation of Facilities to Centre of Excellence (CoE)
Ministry Of Ayush

The scheme-component aims to support the establishment and up-gradation of reputed institutions to Centres of Excellence for strengthening AYUSH education, research, innovation, and advanced healthcare services.
Market Development Assistance
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

The scheme aims to promote organic fertilizers produced at Bio-Gas and Compressed Bio-Gas plants under the Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan initiative. It provides Market Development Assistance of ₹1,500/- per Metric Tonne to manufacturing and marketing entities of organic fertilizers.
Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, in November 2008. Under the scheme, dedicated outlets known as Janaushadhi Kendras are opened to make quality generic medicines available to all at affordable prices.
ICRO Amrit Internship Programme
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

The IPL Centre for Rural Outreach (ICRO) has launched ICRO Amrit Internship Programme focused on youth productivity for prosperity. The interns will be placed at the headquarters and Regional Offices of NPC/ IPL. The duration of the internship will be 3 months initially, renewable up to four times.
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

The scheme provides financial incentives on the incremental sales (over Base Year) of pharmaceutical goods and in-vitro diagnostic medical devices to selected applicants based on pre-defined selection criteria. The applicant must be a manufacturer of pharmaceutical goods.
Petrochemicals Research & Innovation Commendation
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

The scheme aims to felicitate meritorious innovations in petrochemicals. It provides a citation, a memento, and Travel Allowance and Dearness Allowance for attending the ceremony to eligible Indian citizens, institutions, industries, and start-ups.
Chemical Promotion Development Scheme
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

The scheme aims to facilitate the growth and development of the chemicals and petrochemicals industry through knowledge creation, dissemination, and excellence awards. It provides Grants-in-Aid to organisations and industry associations for conducting studies, seminars, and workshops.
Scheme for Setting Up of Centre of Excellence
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

The scheme aims to provide strategic funding for collaborative research and development in the chemicals and petrochemicals sector. It provides a grant of up to ₹5,00,00,000/- to existing Government universities and organizations for research equipment, staff, and technology commercialization.

Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Promotion of Domestic Manufacturing of Critical Key Starting Materials (KSMs)/ Drug Intermediates (DIs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) in India
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

The objective of the Scheme is to attain self-reliance and reduce import dependence in critical KSMs/DIs/APIs. Under the Scheme, financial incentives shall be given based on threshold investment and domestic sales made by selected applicant for the eligible products.
Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Promoting Domestic Manufacturing of Medical Devices
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers
The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial incentive to boost domestic manufacturing and attract large investments in the Medical Device Sector.
Scheme for Setting Up of Plastic Parks
Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers

The scheme aims to increase the competitiveness and value addition in the plastic processing industry through cluster development. It provides grant-in-aid up to ₹40,00,00,000/- for common infrastructure benefits intended for Special Purpose Vehicles and local enterprises.
Summer Internship Scheme Of DGFT
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The Summer Internship Scheme by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade is for the interaction of the officers of the Directorate with young scholars and researchers with brilliant academic backgrounds from reputed academic institutions pursuing Studies/Research in Public Policy/Economics/Law etc.
One District One Product (ODOP) Awards
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme aims to recognize and celebrate the outstanding efforts of States, UTs, Districts, and Indian Missions Abroad in promoting local products. It also seeks to boost economic development and support the Hon’ble Prime Minister’s vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat.
Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee" by the Coffee Board, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, aims to facilitate afforestation in the Jhum lands and help settle the tribals on a permanent footing.
Scheme For Grant Of Rewards To The Children Of Salt Labourers
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme “Scheme for Grant of Rewards to the Children of Salt Labourers” was launched by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry in the year 1985.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: \Small Cardamom Replanting/New Planting: Karnataka (Ha.) and other States
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

To motivate growers in Karnataka and other states to improve production and productivity through systematic replanting of diseased, old, and senile plantations, and to promote area expansion under cultivation.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rain water harvesting structure (nos)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

Under this scheme to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development by constructing rain water harvesting structures for increasing the productivity and improving quality of small cardamom.

Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Polisher for Small Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Turmeric, etc (nos)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
The scheme aims to encourage spice growers to adopt proper polishing methods for spices such as small cardamom, large cardamom, and turmeric to improve their appearance, quality, and marketability.
Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Water Augmentation
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme "Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Water Augmentation" by the Coffee Board, Department of Commerce, aims to improve the production and productivity of coffee plantations by encouraging water augmentation in traditional areas.
Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation" aims to improve the productivity and quality of coffee by facilitating the creation of infrastructure for water augmentation for irrigation and wet processing of coffee.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production:Large Cardamom Replanting/New planting (Ha)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

Under this scheme, growers are encouraged to adopt systematic replanting of large cardamom using high-yielding, disease-free planting materials. It aims to increase productivity, improve quality, and enhance export competitiveness under the Spices Board of India.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation / water storage structures(nos)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom.
Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of Lakadong turmeric (Ha)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

To promote the cultivation of Lakadong turmeric for exports by providing 50% of the cost of planting material, subject to a maximum of ₹ 30,000 per Ha, to turmeric growers of the North East having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Reintroduced subcomponents:Supply of Silpaulin Sheets (nos)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
The objective of the scheme is to encourage spice growers to adopt hygienic drying practices by using Silpaulin Sheets, thereby improving the quality of spices.

Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents:FRESH-IT (Farmer’s Research & Enterprise in Spice Holdings for Innovative Technology)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

To encourage spice farmers to adopt innovative technologies and develop improved spice varieties and cost-effective post-harvest machinery to enhance the production, productivity, and quality of spices.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents:Weather Based Insurance Scheme for small cardamom
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

To protect small cardamom growers against the adverse weather incidences such as deficit or excess rainfall, heat (temperature), relative humidity, etc. which are deemed to adversely affect the production.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme "Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)" is a Sub-Scheme of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom by the Spice Board, Department of Commerce and Industry, Ministry of Commerce.
Logistics Excellence, Advancement, and Performance Shield
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme aims to acknowledge and celebrate best practices and innovations in the logistics industry across sectors. It also aims to promote sustainability, efficiency, and technological advancement in alignment with national logistics initiatives.
NPC Students Internship Program
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

National Productivity Council (NPC) provides internship training to students pursuing graduation and post-graduation. The interns shall be given exposure to related interventions being activities undertaken by NPC which will provide opportunities to learn and implement new concepts.
Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Drying Yards
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme "Quality Upgradation / Certification: Drying Yards" aims to facilitate the improvement of the quality of coffee produced by growers by encouraging them to establish infrastructure for quality enhancement and obtain certification for their coffees, enabling them to earn better returns.
Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation equipment (nos)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom.
Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rainwater harvesting structure(nos)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: \Small Cardamom Replanting/New Planting: For Kerala & Tamilnadu
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
Under this scheme to motivate growers to improve production and productivity through systematic replanting of diseased, old, and senile plantations, and to undertake area expansion.

Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom : Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation / Water Storage Structure (nos)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

Under this scheme, to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development by constructing water storage structures for increasing the productivity and improving quality of small cardamom.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming: Organic Certification Groups
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
Under this scheme to support farmer groups/FPOs in acquiring organic certification for the farm which is a prerequisite for marketing of organic spices.
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Seed spice thresher (nos)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
To motivate the farmers to adopt hygienic threshing practices for production of quality seed spices using mechanical seed spices threshers (power operated)
Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents: Basic quality testing of spices
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry
To promote field-level basic quality testing of spices, enabling farmers to assess produce quality, negotiate better prices, and receive fair value for their produce.
Welfare Measures for Children of Labourers
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

This scheme aims to provide welfare measures in the form of educational stipends, incentives for academic excellence, and financial support for higher education to the children of SC/ST labourers who demonstrate exceptional academic performance and pursue higher education after 10th grade.
Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme “Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations” was launched by the Rubber Board, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India to motivate tappers and retain them in the tapping job.
Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Consolidation of Coffee
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme "Consolidation of Coffee" aims to increase the productivity of the existing coffee holdings by gap filling or rejuvenation, followed by improved cultivation methods such as application of compost, bush management, shade management, pest and disease control, etc.
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

The scheme targets manufacturers of components / sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights and offers 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.
Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of NE ginger (Ha)
Ministry Of Commerce And Industry

Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: ICCD for Small Cardamom (nos) (Improved Cardamom Curing Devices)

National Startup Awards

The National Startup Awards by Startup India aims to recognize and reward outstanding startups and ecosystem enablers building innovative products or solutions and scalable enterprises.
Export Promotion Capital Goods Scheme

Advance Authorisation(AA)

Agriculture And Processed Foods Export Promotion Scheme Of APEDA For The 15th Finance Commission Cycle (2021-22 To 2025-26)

Tea Development and Promotion Scheme (TDPS): Plantation Development for Small Tea Growers (PDSTG): Mechanization for Individual Small Growers

Startup India Seed Fund Scheme- For Incubators

Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries

National Savings Time Deposit (TD)

National Savings Recurring Deposit Account(RD)

The objective of the National Savings Recurring Deposit (RD) scheme is to encourage people to save small amounts regularly every month and build savings with safe returns at 6.7% per annum.
Post Office Savings Account(SB)

Public Provident Fund Account(PPF)

TEC Internship Scheme
Ministry Of Communication

This scheme promotes cultural activities across states and fosters unity while providing opportunities for creative expression and learning, especially for the youth.

Scheme Of Financial Assistance For The Preservation And Development Of Cultural Heritage Of The Himalayas

The scheme “Scheme of Financial Assistance for the Preservation and Development of Cultural Heritage of the Himalayas” was launched by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.

Scheme of Publication Grant/Subsidy for Publication of Doctoral Thesis/Research Report/ Papers Presented in Seminars/Conferences, etc.

The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, provides financial assistance for the publication of high-quality doctoral theses, research project/fellowship reports, and seminar/conference papers in the field of social sciences.
AICTE – Mitacs Globalink Research Internship (GRI) Scheme
Ministry of Education

The scheme aims to promote collaborative research between India and Canada. Through this scheme, fully funded international research internships are provided to eligible Indian undergraduate students.
Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
Ministry of Education

University Grants Commission is implementing the scheme of Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm courses (including integrated dual degree courses).
CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme For Single Girl Child
Ministry of Education
The scheme aims to promote girls’ education and provide ₹1,000 per month to meritorious single girl students studying in classes 11th and 12th.
Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant For Newly Recruited Faculty Members
Ministry of Education

The scheme "Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant for Newly Recruited Faculty Members" is a research grant scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education (DoHE). The purpose of the research grant is to provide opportunities to regularly appointed faculty members.
Post Doctoral Fellowship To Women Candidates
Ministry of Education

The UGC has initiated a scheme of “Post Doctoral Fellowship for Women” to those candidates, who are unemployed holding Ph.D. degree in their respective subject areas with an aim to accelerate the talented instincts of the women candidates to carry out the advanced studies and research.
Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC) Scheme - For Fellows
Ministry of Education

The scheme is a flagship national initiative that aims to attract & engage leading Indian-origin researchers, scientists & professionals from abroad & place them at premier government higher education institutions & national research laboratories in India to undertake cutting-edge research.
Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
Ministry of Education

The Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship (RGNF) Scheme for Scheduled Caste is formulated and funded by the Ministry of Social Justice &Empowerment. The scheme is open to candidates who belong to Scheduled Caste and are pursuing higher studies such as regular and full-time M.Phil.and Ph.D.degrees.
Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals
Ministry of Education

The scheme was initiated keeping in view the political and cultural bilateral relations of India with other developing countries: Asia, Africa, Latin America. The scheme has opened new vistas for foreign students and teachers, enable them to come to India and undertake advanced studies and research.
AICTE-INAE Distinguished Visiting Professorship Scheme
Ministry of Education
All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE) distinguished visiting Professor scheme envisages promotion of industry-institute interaction.
AICTE-National Initiative for Training of Technical Teachers (for Inductee Teachers) Scheme
Ministry of Education

Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD) and All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) jointly proposed an initiative called “National Initiative for Technical Teachers Training (NITTT)” to address the technical teachers of the country who plays an active role in the technical education
Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
Ministry of Education

The "Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (Pm-vidyalaxmi) Scheme" aims to provide financial support for higher education through education loans. Under this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- is provided to meritorious students seeking admission to domestic institutions.
BSR Fellowship Scheme for Science Students - UGC
Ministry of Education
The objective of the scheme is to provide opportunities to meritorious candidates to undertake advanced studies and research leading to Ph.D. degrees in sciences.
National Scheme Of Incentive To Girls For Secondary Education
Ministry of Education

The National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education promotes the girl child's enrolment of 14-18 years age group at secondary stage, who passes class 8th and subsequently drops out for various socio-economic reasons.
Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child
Ministry of Education

Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) is a Fellowship Scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education, for pursuing research work leading to the award of a Ph.D. degree. The target group of this scheme is the ‘single girl child'.
Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers
Ministry of Education

Financial assistance scheme providing up to ₹36,000 annually to visually challenged permanent college teachers for reader assistance, Braille books, and learning aids. Implemented by University Grants Commission to support teaching, research, and academic independence.
Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
Ministry of Education

A scholarship scheme by MoE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical degree course in an AICTE approved institution. The benefits are provided for max. 4 years for first-year admitted students and max. 3 years for second-year admitted students through lateral entry.
Quality Improvement Programme (QIP)
Ministry of Education

The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the expertise and capabilities of faculty members in degree and diploma-level institutions across the country. The aim is to enable teachers to acquire Master's and Doctoral degrees and instil in them a culture of research.
Post Doctoral Fellowship to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Candidates
Ministry of Education

This scheme has been initiated keeping in view social background of candidates from the deprived section of society and to provide them an opportunity to undertake advanced studies and research in Science, Engineering & Technology, Humanities and Social Sciences in Indian Universities/Institutions.
Post Graduate Scholarship for University Rank Holders Scheme
Ministry of Education

The scheme aims to attract talented students towards higher education and promote academic excellence at the postgraduate level. The scholarship is tenable for the full duration of the postgraduate course, subject to a maximum period of two years.
Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC) Scheme - For Host Institutions
Ministry of Education

The scheme is a flagship national initiative that aims to attract & engage leading Indian-origin researchers, scientists & professionals from abroad & place them at premier government higher education institutions & national research laboratories in India to undertake cutting-edge research.
Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
Ministry of Education

The scheme of Junior Research Fellowship in Sciences, Humanities, and Social Science by UGC, Dept. of Education, is open to candidates who qualify for the National Eligibility Test-Junior Research Fellowship(NET-JRF) of the UGC and the UGC-Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (UGC-CSIR).
Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships In Sciences
Ministry of Education

Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships in Sciences was introduced by the UGC. In addition to the existing RA/PDF positions provided by various funding agencies, a need was felt for a PDF scheme running in a flexible mode, with fast track, online handling, and decision-making.
National Scheme of Apprenticeship Training
Ministry of Education

The primary goal of this scheme is to bridge the gap in practical experience for fresh Graduate Engineers, Diploma holders, and 10+2 Vocational pass-outs in approximately 10,000 industrial establishments. The apprentices undergo a one-year training period, receiving a monthly stipend.
AICTE-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT (FOREIGN UNIVERSITY) PROGRAMME
Ministry of Education

The All India Council for Technical Education in its 55th Meeting of the Council held on 14th August 2018 approved the Quality Improvement Programme (Foreign University) (QIP-FU). The QIP(FU) is an extension of the QIP program launched by the Government of India in the year 1970.
AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation Scheme
Ministry of Education

AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation scheme has been launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to promote the use of 'Scheduled Regional Language' in Technical Education for creating knowledge base in local language.
Visitor's Award
Ministry of Education
The Awards are given to recognize excellence in research and innovation of faculty members/researchers of the Central Universities
“Ishan Uday” Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region
Ministry of Education

A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Education and the University Grants Commission. Taking special interest with regard to the promotion of higher education in the NER, i.e. for improving the GER, promoting higher education, and encouraging children belonging to the economically weaker sections.
Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
Ministry of Education

AICTE in order to ensure the development of technical education in India awards Post Graduate Scholarship of ₹12,400/- per month to full-time GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to AICTE approved post-graduate programs in AICTE approved Institutions/University Dept. as per AICTE approved intake.
VAANI (Vibrant Advocacy for Advancement and Nurturing of Indian Languages)
Ministry of Education

The scheme aims to create a knowledge base by conducting conferences, seminars, and workshops in twenty-two Indian languages. The scheme provides a maximum funding of ₹2,00,000/- per programme to eligible institutions, along with an honorarium of up to ₹5,000/- per session for subject experts.
AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Diploma)
Ministry of Education

Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young specially-abled student the opportunity to study further.
Financial Support Scheme
Ministry of Education
The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to financially weak students of the University of Delhi to help them overcome financial challenges and continue their education without hardship.
AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
Ministry of Education

The scheme "AICTE - Grant for Augmenting Infrastructure in North Eastern Region (GAINER)" was introduced by AICTE to enhance the functional efficiency of the technical institutes located in far-flung areas of North East India, by addressing deficiencies in water, electricity, and internet.
AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
Ministry of Education
AICTE-ISTE Induction/ Refresher Programme provide financial assistance to AICTE approved institutions/universities in conducting training for the teaching faculties working in technical institutions.
AICTE - YOUTH UNDERTAKING VISIT FOR ACQUIRING KNOWLEDGE (YUVAK): STUDY TOUR OF ATAL TUNNEL, HIMACHAL PRADESH
Ministry of Education
The scheme is intended for providing Financial Grant for conducting a Study Tour of ATAL TUNNEL by Students / faculty of AICTE approved Institutions in the field of technical education.
AICTE SHORT TERM TRAINING PROGRAMME-SFURTI SCHEME
Ministry of Education

Short Term Training Programme-SFURTI Program aims to provide financial assistance from AICTE to the institutions for conducting faculty and student trainings to enable faculty members and students in the field of technical education.
AICTE-Margdarshan scheme
Ministry of Education

Margdarshan Initiative has been introduced by All India Council for Technical Education in 2018 for facilitating the technical institutes in order to improve the quality of technical education as a whole through accreditation by providing access to the facilities available in host institute.
Institutions of Eminence scheme
Ministry of Education
Institutions of Eminence scheme has been launched in order to empower Higher Educational Institutions and to help them become world class teaching and research institutions.
AICTE-SHORT TERM TRAINING PROGRAMME (STTP) (UT-J&K,LADAKH AND NER)
Ministry of Education
AICTE-Short Term Training Program (STTP) intends to conduct faculty training through financial assistance from AICTE to enable faculty members in the field of technical education.
AICTE- Technical University Joint Training Programs for Librarians
Ministry of Education

AICTE- Technical University Joint Training Programs for Librarians, aims to provide financial assistance in conducting training to librarians to prepare them for being successful and effective in a knowledge society.
AICTE-Training programs for Physical Education Trainers/Sport-Games Teachers/Director of Sports
Ministry of Education

Training programs for Physical Education Trainers/Sport-Games Teachers/Director of Sports, aims to support institution in conducting trainings to develop the skill of the participants to involve the masses in traditional sports/games and fun games for physical activity through recreation.
AICTE Grant for Organizing Conference
Ministry of Education

The scheme provides financial assistance to institutions for organizing conferences in various fields of science and technology, management, and hotel management, including BBA, BCA and BMS institutions.
Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS)
Ministry of Education

Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS) has been introduced by the All India Council for Technical Education to support innovation & research across institutes with collaboration among TEQIP Faculty, Regular faculty of Project institutions (focus and non-focus) & Premier institutions of the country.
Scheme of Development Assistance to Colleges for the Construction of Buildings
Ministry of Education

The scheme aims to provide development assistance to Colleges to help in the consolidation and expansion of infrastructure. Financial assistance is provided to eligible Colleges for the construction and renovation of essential buildings like classrooms, laboratories, and hostels.
AICTE-PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT SCHEME
Ministry of Education
AICTE-Professional Development Scheme enables meritorious faculty to interact at International Level Conferences, both within and outside India, Seminars, and Symposia.
Scheme For Campus Accommodation & Facilities Enhancing Social Experience
Ministry of Education

"Scheme for Campus Accommodation & Facilities Enhancing Social Experience (CAFES)" was introduced by AICTE to provide financial assistance for construction of hostel to create a congenial study atmosphere free from the shackles of domestic shores so as to encourage students to purse their education.
AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
Ministry of Education

AICTE-SPICES scheme provides financial support to institutions for developing students' clubs for the well-rounded development of students by promoting their interests, creativity, and ethics. This club should serve as a model for other clubs in the institution and also those in other institutions.
AICTE e-Shodh Sindhu Scheme (eSS)
Ministry of Education
AICTE e-Shodh Sindhu Scheme (eSS) provides subscriptions of e-Resources like Web of Science, Scopus, ASME, ASCE and Bentham Science to institutions.
Scheme of Grants-in-Aid for supporting professional associations/ organisations of social scientists, companies and trusts duly registered under the Companies Act for their development
Ministry of Education

The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, provides Grants-in-Aid for supporting professional associations/ organisations of social scientists, companies and trusts for their development.
AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
Ministry of Education

Through Idea Lab Scheme, AICTE will be setting up Idea Labs in AICTE approved institutions to encourage students for application of science, technology engineering and mathematics (STEM) fundamentals towards enhanced hands-on experience, learning by doing and even product visualization.
Modernisation And Removal Of Obsolescence
Ministry of Education

MODROB scheme, one of the AICTE Quality Improvement Scheme (AQIS), intends to support the development of laboratories with appropriate equipment/ technology/ tools/ software and encourages financial contribution from the industry.

Ministry Of External Affairs

The Ministry of External Affairs launched the first edition of the Internship Programme in 2022. The internship policy aims to take foreign policy closer to the people. A total of 75 internships will be offered in the year 2022 in a single term of three months during April to June 2022.
Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)
Ministry Of External Affairs

ICCR provides an excellent opportunity for budding scholars to familiarise themselves with the role of soft power in foreign policy formulation in the Govt of India. These ‘Interns’ would be expected to supplement the process of analysis in various fields (creative writing, cultural mapping, etc).
Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana

A mandatory insurance scheme by Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) for safeguarding the interests of Indian emigrant workers falling under Emigration Check Required (ECR) category going for overseas employment to ECR countries.
Awarding Teleeducation Scholarships To Afghan Students
Ministry Of External Affairs

The "Awarding Teleeducation Scholarships To Afghan Students" scheme under e-VidyaBharati Network Project, launched by the Ministry of External Affairs, offers 1000 annual scholarships to Afghan students for UGC-approved online UG and PG programs from Indian universities.
Indian Community Welfare Fund
Ministry Of External Affairs

A scheme by Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) for the welfare of Overseas Indians; assisting them in distress situations. ICWF has also been a critical support in emergency evacuation of Indian nationals from conflict zones, countries affected by natural disasters and other challenging situations.
Stand-Up India
Ministry Of Finance

A scheme by Ministry of Finance for financing SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs by facilitating bank loans for setting up a greenfield project Enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading sector and activities allied to agriculture.
Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
Ministry Of Finance
An Accident Insurance Scheme offering accidental death and disability cover for death or disability on account of an accident.
Indirect Tax Internship Scheme In Central Board Of Indirect Taxes And Customs (CBIC)

The "Indirect Tax Internship Scheme" by CBIC takes Law Students/ Graduates as Interns every year. The interns are expected to study case files, assist in legal research and drafting of petitions, brief the counsels and extend any other related legal/general assistance to officers/counsels.
National Savings (Monthly Income Account) Scheme
Ministry Of Finance
The scheme provides a fixed monthly income to investors through periodic interest payments on a one-time deposit made at the time of account opening.
NPS Vatsalya Scheme

NPS Vatsalya is a contributory saving cum long-term financial security scheme designed exclusively for minors for the purposes of enhancing financial literacy and financial planning and to encourage empowerment of children, emanating from the vision of "Viksit Bharat@2047.
Atal Pension Yojana
Ministry Of Finance

Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is an old age income security scheme for a savings account holder in the age group of 18-40 years, who is not an income tax-payee. It helps to address longevity risks among workers in unorganized sector and encourages the workers to voluntarily save for retirement.
Internship Programme Of The Department Of Expenditure
Ministry Of Finance

The Internship Programme of the Department of Expenditure aims to familiarize willing and eligible undergraduates pursuing five-year integrated courses and Graduates pursuing post-Graduation/ post-Graduates pursuing Research with the overall process of formulation of economic policies of the Govt.
Internship Scheme Of The Department Of Economic Affairs
Ministry Of Finance

The Internship Scheme aims to familiarise students with macro-economic policy formulation and economic research. Through this scheme, internship opportunities with token remuneration are provided to eligible Post Graduate and PhD students.
Senior Citizens Saving Scheme
Ministry Of Finance

Introduced in 2004 by the Govt. of India, SCSS offers a steady stream of income for individuals over 60 years old. As it is a government-backed scheme, there is minimal risk associated with SCSS. Individuals can apply for this scheme in post offices and public and private banks.
SEBI ITD Internship Program
Ministry Of Finance

The SEBI ITD Internship Program provides hands-on training to the students of the institutes based in and around Mumbai. The program accepts up to 15 interns. The Interns accepted under this program would be given an opportunity to work on different Information Technology (IT) projects.
Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

National Savings Certificates (VIII-Issue) Scheme

The scheme “National Savings Certificates (VIII-Issue) Scheme” was launched by the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, Government of India to promote a culture of long-term savings among individuals.
Varishtha Pension Bima Yojana
Ministry Of Finance

The scheme aims to provide a pension scheme for senior citizens. Through this scheme, immediate annuity, pension, and return of purchase price on death are provided to citizens aged 60 years and above.
SMILE - Comprehensive Rehabilitation For Welfare Of Transgender Persons – Skill Development And Training
Ministry Of Finance
The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to the person belonging to transgender person community by providing them market-oriented skills.
Mahila Samman Savings Certificate
Ministry Of Finance
The scheme aims to provide a secure savings option with assured returns for women. Through this scheme, 7.5% interest and flexible savings benefits are provided to women and minor girls.
Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
Ministry Of Finance
The scheme aims to ensure food security for the poor. Through this scheme, free foodgrains are provided to eligible ration card holders under the National Food Security Act, 2013.
Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana

Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is a flagship scheme of Government of India. It facilitates micro credit/Loan upto Rs. 20 lakhs to income generating micro enterprises engaged in the non farm sector in manufacturing, processing, trading or service sector including activities allied to agriculture
Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana

Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme
