rawCardText: Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

The Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying introduced the National Livestock Mission as umbrella scheme. The "Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry" is the realigned National Livestock Mission, which is the scheme's sub-mission.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-yojana (PM-MKSSY): COMPONENT 1B: One-Time Incentive for the Adoption of Aquaculture Insurance
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

The Component 1B of PM-MKSSY provides a one-time incentive to eligible applicants who have availed institutional credit for fisheries-related activities. The objective is to encourage formal credit adoption and support the repayment capacity of fisheries microenterprises.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for sheep and goat
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

Under the Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for Sheep and Goat Scheme, the Central Government will provide assistance for the establishment of frozen semen production laboratories for goats and liquid semen production laboratories for sheep at the regional level.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: National Livestock Mission: Establishment of Entrepreneurship for Breed Development of Rural Poultry
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in rural poultry farming. Through this scheme, a 50% capital subsidy is provided for establishing Parent Farms, Rural Hatcheries, and Brooder cum Mother Units.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig breeds - Establishment of Pig Semen Collection and Processing Lab
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

The Scheme aims to enhance per-animal productivity, reduce inbreeding, and minimize sexually transmitted diseases in pigs. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for establishing semen processing labs at government pig farms.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: National Livestock Mission: Promotion of Piggery Entrepreneur
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in pig farming by providing a one-time capital subsidy of up to ₹30 lakh to eligible entrepreneurs and organizations to establish breeder farms.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

Introduced by the Department of Fisheries, Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) is a scheme to bring about ecologically healthy, economically viable, and socially inclusive development of the fisheries sector of India.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: National Livestock Mission: Establishment of State Semen Bank
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

"Establishment of State Semen Bank (Genetic Improvement of Sheep and Goat breeds)" aims at the genetic improvement of sheep/goat breeds through selective breeding by propagation of superior male germplasm through artificial insemination.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: Livestock Health and Diseases Control
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

The Livestock Health and Diseases Control (LH&DC) scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India.

categories: ministry:Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
rawCardText: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig Breeds - Import of Exotic Pig Germplasm
Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying

The scheme aims to enhance indigenous pig productivity through genetic upgradation. The scheme supports the establishment of pig semen collection and processing labs and the import of exotic pig germplasm.
Pradhan Mantri Formalisation Of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
Ministry of Food Processing Industries

Launched on 29th June 2020, PMFMPE is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme by the MoFPI, designed to address the challenges faced by the micro enterprises and to tap the potential of groups and cooperatives in supporting the upgradation and formalization of these enterprises.
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Food Processing Industry
Ministry of Food Processing Industries
The scheme aims to promote food manufacturing, branding, and employment. Through this scheme, financial incentives and branding support are provided to food processing entities.
Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Millet Based Products
Ministry of Food Processing Industries
The scheme aims to increase usage of millets and promote value-added millet products. Through this scheme, financial incentives on incremental sales are provided to eligible manufacturers.
Health Minister’s Discretionary Grant
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

A health scheme by Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for financially poor patients to defray a part of the expenditure on Hospitalization/treatment in Government Hospitals,for life threatening diseases covered under Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN), in cases where free medical facilities aren't there.
Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

The scheme aims to provide fixed-day assured, comprehensive and quality antenatal care universally to all pregnant women in 2nd and 3rd trimester on the 9th of every month. It offers free comprehensive antenatal care services at government health facilities.
Nikshay Poshan Yojana
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India has announced the scheme for incentives for nutritional support to TB patients. This scheme will be called “Nikshay Poshan Yojana”.
Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

The scheme aims to provide completely free and cashless delivery, including caesarean section, for pregnant women at government health facilities along with free treatment for sick newborns and infants.
ICMR- Post Doctoral Fellowship
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

ICMR- Post Doctoral Fellowship (ICMR-PDF) Scheme is being instituted to foster high-quality research opportunities for promising fresh Ph.D./MD/MS holders in the areas of basic science, communicable and non-communicable diseases, & reproductive health including nutrition at ICMR Institutes/Centers.
Long Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

Long Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research aims to provide advanced training in India and abroad to medical and health research personnel in cutting-edge research areas related to medicine and health.
Food Safety & Standards Authority Of India (FSSAI) Internship Scheme
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

The Internship Program by the FSSAI provides interns with unique learning opportunities in various areas of food regulation of food safety administration. FSSAI is a statutory body established under the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 under the aegis of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare.
Rastriya Arogya Nidhi - Health Minister’s Cancer Patient Fund
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare
The scheme-component aims to provide financial assistance to poor patients living below the poverty line and suffering from cancer, for their treatment at 27 Regional Cancer Centers (RCCs).
Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package : Insurance Scheme For Health Workers Fighting COVID-19
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare
The scheme aims to provide financial protection through insurance cover of ₹50,00,000/- to healthcare workers fighting COVID-19.
National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) Internship Programme
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

NACO initiated the Internship Programme for young students who wish to engage with the Government. The internship programme envisages an opportunity for young students to get familiar with and understand the various dimensions of policy-making & implementation of the National AIDS Control Programme.
Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

The scheme aims to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by promoting institutional deliveries among poor pregnant women. It offers cash assistance for institutional and home deliveries, along with antenatal and postnatal care support, primarily benefiting poor pregnant women across India.
ICMR-Junior Research Fellowship
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and research opportunities to eligible candidates through Junior Research Fellowship for pursuing Ph.D. programmes in medical and social science fields.
Short Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare
The scheme aims to provide short-term advanced training and financial support to medical and health research personnel to enhance their skills and promote research in priority health areas.
Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

AB PM-JAY is a health insurance scheme for low-income families in rural and urban areas. The scheme aims to provide affordable healthcare facilities to the Poor. It is the largest health assurance scheme in the world which aims at providing a health cover of ₹5,00,000/- per family per year.
Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana
Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare
The scheme aims to provide assured, dignified, and completely free healthcare services to all pregnant women, mothers, and newborns at public health facilities.
GST Exemption Certificate Scheme
Ministry of Heavy Industries

"GST Exemption Certificate Scheme" has been introduced by the Dept. of Heavy Industries, for issuing certificates to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) having a disability percentage equal to or greater than 40%. The scheme provides GSC Concession to orthopedically disabled persons on purchase of car.
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme For National Programme on Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage
Ministry of Heavy Industries
The scheme aims to promote giga-scale ACC manufacturing in India. Through this scheme, financial incentives are provided to selected firms to boost domestic battery manufacturing and reduce imports.
Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
Ministry of Heavy Industries

The government of India has launched the scheme “Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components Industry” in India to enhance India’s Manufacturing Capabilities for Advanced Automotive Products.
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components Industry
Ministry of Heavy Industries
The scheme offers financial incentives to boost domestic manufacturing of Advanced Automotive Technology products and attract investments in the automotive manufacturing value chain.
Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme
Ministry Of Home Affairs

Launched on 15th August 1972, "Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme" is a Pension Scheme by the Ministry of Home Affairs. The scheme provides the grant of pension to living freedom fighters and their families; if they are no more alive, and to the families or martyrs.
Police Medal for Meritorious Service
Ministry Of Home Affairs
Under this scheme, medals, official recognition, and service distinction are provided to the personnel serving in police, CAPFs, CPOs, and other public safety organizations.
Padma Awards
Ministry Of Home Affairs
The scheme aims to recognize distinguished and exceptional achievements across various fields of public service and national importance.
Gallantry Medal – PMG/GM
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme aims to honour exceptional and conspicuous acts of gallantry. Through this scheme, medals, a Presidential scroll, and monthly monetary allowances are provided to eligible service personnel.
Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
Ministry Of Home Affairs
The scheme aims to recognize bravery in saving lives and provide medals, certificates, and financial allowances to deserving individuals.
President’s Medal for Distinguished Service
Ministry Of Home Affairs
The scheme aims to recognize exceptional service, distinguished records, and meritorious contributions in police, security, fire, prison, and civil defence services.
Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for the Wards of Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme aims to encourage higher technical and professional education for dependent wards and widows of CAPFs/Assam Rifles personnel martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks. Through this scheme, Financial support per year for girls and boys is provided.
Security Related Expenditure (Relief and Rehabilitation)
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme aims to support the relief and rehabilitation of the Kashmiri migrants who have been uprooted from the Valley during the militancy period besides other relief & rehabilitation measures. "SRE (R&R) Scheme" is a component of the Umbrella scheme, 'Modernization of Police Forces (MPF)".
Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for the Wards/Widows of Central Police Force Personnel
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme aims to encourage higher technical and professional education for the wards of widows and ex-CPF personnel. Service conditions of Central Police Forces (CPFs) Personnel are extremely exacting, tough, rigorous, and peculiar to the Services.
Land Ports Authority Of India (LPAI) Internship Scheme
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The Land Ports Authority of India (LPAI) is pleased to announce its annual internship program for the academic year 2025-26. This program provides a unique opportunity for students and research scholars from BBIN countries (Bhutan, India, Nepal, and Bangladesh) to gain practical experience in LPAI
Union Home Minister’s Medal for Excellence in Police Training
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme aims to recognize the crucial role of trainers and support staff in police organizations, making training a respectable assignment and promoting high quality in police training institutes. It provides recognition, a Certificate (Scroll), and a cash reward of ₹25,000/- to trainers.
Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme aims to recognize excellent work, promote high professional standards, and boost morale of personnel serving in police forces, security organizations, intelligence units, and forensic science institutions across India.
Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
Ministry Of Home Affairs
The scheme aims to encourage original and translated book writing in Hindi. Through this scheme, monetary awards, certificates, and mementos are provided to Indian authors.
Relief and Rehabilitation Assistance to Sri Lankan Refugees in the Refugee Camps
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme provides relief materials, which among other things include Feeding Charges, Subsidized Rice, Clothing Materials, Utensils, Transportation Charges (on arrival), Porterage and Transport (on repatriation), Cash Doles, Infrastructure Facilities (at camps), Electricity, Drinking Water, etc.
Central Assistance For One Time Settlement Of Displaced Families From PoK And Chhamb Under Prime Minister's Development Package
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme aims to provide supplementary financial assistance to displaced families for assured and sustained earnings. Through this scheme, one-time financial assistance of ₹5,50,000/- per family is provided to eligible displaced families of PoK and Chhamb settled in Jammu & Kashmir.
Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for the Wards of States/UTs Police Personnel
Ministry Of Home Affairs

The scheme aims to support higher education for dependent wards of States/UTs Police personnel martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks. Through this scheme, financial assistance for girls and boys per year is provided.
Sardar Patel National Unity Award
Ministry Of Home Affairs
Under this scheme, the highest civilian recognition in the field of national unity is provided to individuals or institutions demonstrating exceptional dedication to strengthening the unity of India.
Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar
Ministry Of Home Affairs
The scheme aims to recognize excellent work done by individuals and institutions in the field of disaster management including prevention, mitigation, preparedness, response, and rehabilitation.
PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
Ministry Of Housing & Urban Affairs

PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme launched on 1st June 2020 by the MoHUA to provide handholding support to street vendors. The scheme facilitates a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy.
Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group
Ministry Of Housing & Urban Affairs

Under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme, beneficiaries of Middle-Income Group (MIG) can seek housing loans from Banks, Housing Finance Companies and other such institutions for acquisition/ construction of house (including re-purchase).
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
Ministry Of Housing & Urban Affairs

Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U) Scheme was launched on 25th June 2015 by the Hon’ble Prime Minister to provide all-weather pucca houses to all eligible urban households across the nation with the vision of ‘Housing for All’.
Swachh Bharat Mission – Urban 2.0
Ministry Of Housing & Urban Affairs
A sanitation scheme for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) for urban households.
Atal Mission For Rejuvenation And Urban Transformation
Ministry Of Housing & Urban Affairs

Providing basic services (e.g. water supply, sewerage, urban transport) to households and building amenities in cities which will improve the quality of life for all, especially the poor and the disadvantaged is a national priority.
Supporting Community Radio Movement in India
Ministry Of Information And Broadcasting

The GOI has a policy for grant of License to eligible organisations for setting up of Community Radio Stations. To support the Sector, the Scheme provides financial assistance once the Community Radio is made operational by eligible organisation. The Scheme also has components for capacity building.
Swachh Bharat Mission – Grameen PHASE I
Ministry Of Jal Shakti
The scheme aims to eliminate open defecation and improve rural sanitation by supporting toilet construction and promoting usage among poor and marginalized rural households.
Mass Communication Internship Programme
Ministry Of Jal Shakti

The Mass Communication Internship Programme by the Department of Water Resources, River Development, and Ganga Rejuvenation. The intern program will offer work culture and environment knowledge about the functioning of the Government and its departments in information, education, and communication.
Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II
Ministry Of Jal Shakti
A sanitation scheme for Visual cleanliness through Open Defecation Free (ODF) sustainability and effective management of solid and liquid waste in villages.
Jal Jeevan Mission
Ministry Of Jal Shakti
Jal Jeevan Mission, is envisioned to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections by 2024 to all households in rural India.
National Water Awards
Ministry Of Jal Shakti

The objective of the National Water Awards is to encourage the stakeholders to adopt a holistic approach toward water resource management in the country as surface water and groundwater play a signiﬁcant role in the water cycle.
Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan)
Ministry Of Jal Shakti

GOBARdhan Scheme was launched in April 2018 as a part of the Solid and Liquid Waste Management component under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) to positively impact village cleanliness and generate wealth and energy from cattle and organic waste. The main focus of GOBARDHAN is to keep villages clean.
Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme aims to ensure old age protection for unorganised workers. It provides a minimum assured pension of ₹3,000/- per month and family pension benefits to unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 years who earn less than ₹15,000/- monthly, supported by matching government contributions.
Labour Welfare Scheme (Health)
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme aims to provide comprehensive health care and financial assistance for medical treatments. It offers hospital services, medical reimbursements, and subsistence allowances for beedi, cine, and non-coal mine workers and their dependants.
Social Security for Tea Plantation Workers in Assam
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme aims to provide institutionalized social security cover, including provident funds, pensions, and life insurance. It provides monthly pensions, provident fund advances, and lump-sum death benefits to tea plantation workers in Assam and their dependent families.
Employees' Pension Scheme
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme ensures retirement security for employees covered under the EPF Act, offering monthly pensions, family pensions, and withdrawal benefits. It targets workers in organised sectors, providing financial support post-retirement, during disability, or to dependents after the member’s death.
Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme “Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana (ABVKY)” was introduced by the Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) on a pilot basis for a period of 2 years w.e.f. 01.07.2018 for providing relief to the Insured Persons (IPs) who have become unemployed.
Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme aims to stimulate employment creation, increase workforce formalization, and enhance employability. It provides financial incentives to first-time employees and offers wage subsidies to eligible employers for creating sustained jobs, especially in manufacturing.
National Pension Scheme For Traders And Self Employed Persons
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme aims to provide old age protection and social security to workers in the unorganized sector. It offers an assured monthly pension of ₹3,000/- after age sixty, with matching government contributions, to benefit small shopkeepers, retail traders, and self-employed persons.
Internship Scheme Of The Ministry Of Labour & Employment
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

Through the Internship Scheme, the Ministry of Labour & Employment engage eligible students as “Interns" to work for mutual benefit. The “Interns” shall have an opportunity to know about the Government functioning and Department Policy issues in the Government of India.
Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme aims to fund the pre-matric and post-matric education of wards belonging to specific mine, beedi, and cine workers. It provides annual scholarships between ₹1,000/- and ₹25,000/- based on the student's academic level and course type.
National Career Service Centers For SC/STs (erstwhile Coaching-cum-Guidance Centre for SC/STs)
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme provides vocational guidance, confidence-building programmes, personality development sessions, practice in typing and shorthand, special coaching for competitive exams, and computer training courses. The applicant must be an educated, unemployed SC/ST jobseeker.
Internship Scheme Of Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The Internship Scheme of Employees’ Provident Fund Organization invites applications for Internships from students for engagement as “Interns” with EPFO. The “Interns” shall have an opportunity to know about the EPFO’s functioning and Departmental Policy issues in EPFO and Government of India.
Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The scheme addresses eradicating bonded labour in India. It introduces varying rehabilitation assistance amounts based on beneficiary categories, such as adults, children, women, and extreme cases, with provisions for annuity schemes and Direct Benefit Transfer.
Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
Ministry Of Labour and Employment

The Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a social security scheme for rural landless households implemented by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. The scheme provides insurance coverage to the head of the household or an earning member of the family in the age group of 18 to 59.
Nyaya Mitra Scheme
Ministry Of Law and Justice

The scheme aims to facilitate the expeditious disposal of ten to fifteen years old pending court cases. It provides legal advice, case assistance, and Lok Adalat referrals to marginalized litigants by engaging retired officers.
Scheme for Action Research and Studies on Judicial Reforms
Ministry Of Law and Justice

The scheme provides financial assistance for undertaking action research, evaluation studies, monitoring studies, capacity building, publishing reports, and promoting innovative programmes in the areas of Justice Delivery, Legal Research, and Judicial Reforms.
LLB Internship Programme
Ministry Of Law and Justice

Department of Justice introduced an Internship Programme for young law students. The purpose is to well acquaint law students in the field of research & referencing work, in various specialized areas of justice delivery, such as Tele-Law, Nyaya Bandhu etc.
Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
Ministry Of Law and Justice

The National Green Tribunal provides opportunities to college students by holding Summer Internship Programs (March, April, May and July ordinarily) and Winter Internship Programs (November, December and January ordinarily) Internship Programs for LL.B./ LL.M./ Env. Studies/ Research Students.
Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law
Ministry Of Law and Justice

The scheme aims to propagate and develop literature in the field of law in Hindi and other regional languages. It provides financial grants to voluntary organisations for publishing legal books, commentaries, and journals.

Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme aims to increase productivity and wages of Khadi artisans, improve production infrastructure, boost employment and sales, revive traditional rural skills, modernize sales outlets, and promote marketing and exports.

rawCardText: Coir Udyami Yojana
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme "Coir Udyami Yojana" by the Coir Board, Ministry of MSME, Government of India, aims to modernize the coir industry and generate rural employment. It offers credit-linked financial assistance to establish coir units by eligible applicants.

rawCardText: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and skill development among youth by providing training and support for setting up MSMEs and self-employment ventures.

rawCardText: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Gramodyog Vikas Yojana
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme aims to increase productivity and wages of Khadi artisans, improve production infrastructure, boost employment and sales, revive traditional rural skills, modernize sales outlets, and promote marketing and exports.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: PM Vishwakarma
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme "PM Vishwakarma " by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, is a new scheme that envisages providing end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople in scaling up their conventional products and services.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Coir Vikas Yojana-Skill Upgradation and Mahila Coir Yojana
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
The scheme “Skill Upgradation and Mahila Coir Yojana” is a component of “Coir Vikas Yojana” and the scheme was launched by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Interest Subsidy Eligibility Certificate (ISEC) Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
The scheme aims to provide concessional working capital loans at 4% interest to khadi institutions through interest subsidy support.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Incubation Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Incubation Scheme aims to promote and support untapped creativity and to promote adoption of latest technologies in MSMEs that seek the validation of their ideas at the proof-of-concept level.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Bank Guarantee Charges Reimbursement Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Under the Ministry Of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Bank Guarantee Charges Reimbursement Scheme is a sub scheme under National Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Hub (NSSH) scheme.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Testing Fee Reimbursement Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Testing Fee Reimbursement Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe is a sub scheme under National Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Hub (NSSH) scheme.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Janshree Bima Yojana for Khadi Artisans
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
The scheme aims to provide insurance cover to Khadi artisans. Through this scheme, group insurance benefits are provided to Khadi artisans (spinners and weavers).

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled scheme aims to facilitate capital subsidy to SC/ST MSEs for purchasing of plant & machinery/equipment through institutional finance (bank loan).

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

Raw Material Assistance Scheme aims to help MSMEs by way of financing the purchase of Raw Material (Both indigenous & imported). This gives an opportunity to MSMEs to focus better on manufacturing quality products.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Coir Vikas Yojana- Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme “Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme (CITUS)” is a component of “Coir Vikas Yojana” and the scheme was launched by Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Modified Market Development Assistance Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme aims to enhance the production and sales of Khadi and Polyvastra products by supporting technology upgradation, market promotion, and providing direct incentives to artisans and Karyakartas. It targets Khadi Institutions and their associated artisans and workers.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: International Cooperation Scheme: Market Development Assistance
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme “International Cooperation Scheme” was launched by the MSME, Govt. of India with the aim to capacity build MSMEs for entering the export market by facilitating their participation in international exhibitions/fairs/conferences/seminars/buyer-seller meets abroad.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

To make the traditional industries more productive and competitive and facilitating their sustainable development, the Govt. of India announced in 2005-06, setting up of a fund for the regeneration of traditional industries. Pursuant to this announcement, a Central Sector Scheme titled the “SFURTI".

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
The Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme comes under the purview of the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) of the Government of India.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Reimbursement of membership Fee in Government promoted E-Commerce Portals
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Reimbursement of Membership fee of Government promoted e-commerce portals Scheme is a sub scheme under National Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Hub (NSSH) scheme.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Personal Accident Insurance Scheme For Coir Workers
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme aims to provide financial compensation to deceased/disabled coir workers and their nominees. Through this scheme, insurance compensation benefits are provided to coir workers in case of accidents and disabilities.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Single Point Registration Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

National Small Industries Corporation enlists Micro & Small Enterprises under Single Point Registration scheme for participation in Government Purchases. The units enlisted under this scheme of NSIC are eligible to get the benefits under Public Procurement Policy for Micro & Small Enterprises.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Assistance to Training Institutions Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for creation, strengthening, and expansion of training institutions under MSME for skill development and entrepreneurship training.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Consortia & Tender Marketing Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

The scheme aims to facilitate Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in marketing their products and services through individual or collective participation in tenders via consortia. It helps MSEs secure bulk orders, improve competitiveness, and access government procurement opportunities.

categories: ministry:Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
rawCardText: Coir Vikas Yojana- Export Market Promotion Scheme
Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The objective of Arjuna Awards is to recognize outstanding achievements of sportspersons in the field of sports at the international level. To be eligible for the award, a sportsperson should have good performance consistently for the previous four years at the international level.
Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports: Assistance for Research
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for sports-related research projects that contribute to the improvement of sports and games in India and promote innovation in sports sciences, medicine, psychology, performance enhancement, and other sports-related disciplines.
National Service Scheme
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The objective of the National Service Scheme (NSS) is to develop the personality and character of students through voluntary community service. The scheme aims to promote social responsibility, leadership, national integration, and a spirit of selfless service among youth.
Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

Named after the hockey wizard Major Dhyan Chand (1905–79), an Indian legendary field hockey player, "Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award" is the highest sporting honour of India. Instituted in 1991–1992, the award is conferred annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
Khelo India Scheme: Creation and Upgradation of Sports Infrastructure
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The scheme component aims to create and upgrade sports infrastructure across the country by providing financial assistance for modern sports facilities, sports science infrastructure, and sports equipment to eligible entities.
Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Exchange of Knowledge / Research / Ideas for Holding Training Programmes, Seminars, Workshops, Clinics and Conferences Within the Country
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports
The scheme aims to strengthen sports knowledge and capacity building by providing financial assistance for organizing training and knowledge-sharing events.
Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

MYAS confers the Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award in order to recognize the achievements of persons associated with the field of adventure and to encourage young people to develop the spirit of endurance, risk-taking, cooperative teamwork, and quick, ready, and effective reflexes.
Scheme of Cash Incentive to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The objective of the scheme is to reward outstanding sportspersons for their achievements at the global level. It aims to simplify eligibility, improve the award process, motivate athletes to achieve higher, and inspire young people to take up sports.
Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports: Publication of Outstanding Works on Sports Related Subjects
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the publication of outstanding works, journals, e-publications, online content, and web-based applications related to sports and games, thereby promoting sports knowledge, research, and awareness among stakeholders and the general public.
Khelo India Scheme: Fit India Movement
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The scheme aims to promote physical fitness among all citizens by encouraging regular physical activity, conducting fitness assessments, certifying schools, and organizing fitness campaigns and events.
Khelo India Scheme: Khelo India Centres and Sports Academies
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The scheme aims to encourage sports across the country by strengthening sports infrastructure, coaching, talent development, and sports academies, thereby promoting excellence in sports and holistic development of children and youth.
Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy Scheme
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The MAKA Trophy instituted in year 1956-57 is a rolling trophy awarded by the Ministry of Sports to the overall top performing University in sports of the preceding year for promoting competitive sports in the university sector with a view to arouse keen interest among students.
Khelo India Scheme: Promotion of Inclusiveness through Sports
Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports

The scheme aims to promote social inclusion, gender equality, peace, development, and participation in sports by supporting rural and indigenous games, sports for women, persons with disabilities, and youth in disturbed areas across the country.

categories: ministry:NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India)
rawCardText: NITI Internship Scheme
NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India)

This Scheme seeks to engage students pursuing Under Graduate/Graduate/Post Graduate Degrees or are Research Scholars enrolled in recognized University/Institution within India or abroad, as "interns". They shall be given exposure to various Verticals/ Divisions/Units within NITI Aayog.
The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme
The Lokpal of India

The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme offers students exposure to anti-corruption laws and institutions. Interns learn about governance, legal frameworks, and contribute ideas to enhance transparency and accountability in public administration.
The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disability Allowance Scheme
Andaman and Nicobar Islands
The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the differently able unemployed persons with 40% disability or more in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
Pension Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

Under this scheme, pension shall be provided to the Building and Other Construction Workers who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board upon attaining the age of 55 years.
The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to the poorest and destitute women in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The scheme “The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to poor and destitute widows in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
Disability Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers who become disabled due to an accident during the course of their employment on the production of a certificate from competent medical authorities in respect of the percentage of disability.
Incentive Scheme For The Electricity Consumers Under Various Categories In Andaman & Nicobar Islands
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

"Incentive Scheme For The Electricity Consumers Under Various Categories In Andaman & Nicobar Islands" aims to reduce power consumption through demand side management and promote green energy adoption. The scheme offers monetary incentives to consumers who achieve at least 30% energy savings.

Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Tribes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India Post-Senior Secondary Courses (Post 10+2 Courses)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The objective of the scheme is to provide additional financial assistance (scholarship) to the ST students pursuing higher education after Senior Secondary i.e. 12th Standard in the Colleges/Universities anywhere in India, as an incentive to supplement the cost of their education.
Andaman & Nicobar Islands Scheme for Health Insurance
Andaman and Nicobar Islands
The Health Insurance (ANISHI) shall provide cashless treatment upto Rupees 5 Lakhs per patients per illness which include indoor and outdoor treatments.
Dulari Scheme
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The DULARI Scheme was implemented by the Directorate of Health Services in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide incentives for newborn baby girls and to the girl children who pass Classes VIII, X, and XII.
Skill Development Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be provided to registered construction workers or their two children for the purchase of tool kits upon submission of a successful course/trade completion certificate from a Government Industrial Training Institute or Vocational Training Centre.

Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students of Other Backward Classes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India after Secondary Level (Except Class XI & XII)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The objective of the scheme is to provide additional scholarship to the OBC students belonging to the non-creamy layer of Andaman & Nicobar Islands for pursuing higher education after Secondary (X)/Senior Secondary (XII), in government-recognized Polytechnic/ITI/College/University anywhere in India.
Andaman & Nicobar Bed & Breakfast / Home Stay Establishment Scheme
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The Directorate of Tourism, Andaman & Nicobar Administration is implementing ‘Andaman & Nicobar Bed & Breakfast/Homestay Scheme’ all over the Island based on the approved guidelines of the Ministry of Tourism, Govt. of India under the scheme “Incredible India Bed & Breakfast/Homestay Establishment”.
The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Old Age Assistance Scheme
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The aim of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to destitute, senior citizens who are without any means of subsistence and having no one to give financial support to them for their livelihood.
Maternity Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The scheme offers maternity benefits to female employees registered as beneficiaries for one year during their maternity period. Additionally, male employees, registered for a year, with wives aged 19 or older and not beneficiaries, are also eligible for maternity benefits.
Medical Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The scheme provides medical assistance to the Building & Other Construction Workers, who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, and his/her dependents' family members during hospitalization due to accident or illness.
Death Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The scheme provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of workers engaged in Building or Other Construction Works in Andaman & Nicobar Islands in the event of their natural or accidental death.
Funeral Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands

The scheme provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of deceased workers who were registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, towards their funeral expenses.
Marriage Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands
Under this scheme, registered construction workers will receive a financial allowance to cover either their own marriage expenses or those of their two dependent children.
Educational Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
Andaman and Nicobar Islands
This scheme provides educational assistance to the son or daughter of a registered construction worker who is studying in any class from Class I to Post Graduate Level/Professional Course.
Veda Vyasa Scheme for Vedic Education
Andhra Pradesh

Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation launched the “Veda Vyasa Scheme for Vedic Education” for the year 2019-20, to encourage Vedic Education in Andhra Pradesh. Under this scheme, selected applicants will be granted Annual Financial Assistance.
Bharati Scheme for Education - 1st Class to 5th Class
Andhra Pradesh

"The Bharati Scheme for Education - 1st Class to 5th Class" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin student applicants.
Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expense
Andhra Pradesh

The "Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expenses" aims to provide financial assistance for funeral expenses of a deceased Brahmin in their family, where the family has no other means to meet the same. This scheme covers Andhra Pradesh all 13 districts, to meet the funeral expenses of the deceased Brahmi.
Sanction of Adult Sticks to Senior Citizens
Andhra Pradesh

The "Sanction of Adult Sticks to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide walking sticks to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to enhance their mobility and independence.
Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Intern
Andhra Pradesh

The "Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Intern (IPCC)" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin students.
Bharati Scheme for Education - Graduation
Andhra Pradesh

The "Bharati Scheme for Education - Graduation (Any regular course of 3 years duration after 10+2 will be considered under this category. i.e., B.A., B.Com, B.Sc., etc., including B.Ed.)" provides financial assistance to encourage Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education.
Vocational Training to the Dependents
Andhra Pradesh

The "Vocational Training to the Dependents" provides a residential skill training program for 15,000 dependents of registered construction workers. The program focuses on enhancing the employability of dependents through training in various trades.
INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Rural)
Andhra Pradesh

"INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)" scheme aims to disburse monthly pensions to widows, irrespective of their age. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of the district, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Urban)
Andhra Pradesh

"INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to destitute elderly persons aged 65 years or above with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, and be a resident of Andhra Pradesh.
Chanakya Scheme for Swayam Upadhi
Andhra Pradesh

The "Chanakya Scheme for Swayam Upadhi” to encourage Brahmin entrepreneurs in Andhra Pradesh. The grant will be given against relevant approved asset acquisition for setting up new business entities or expanding existing/diversifying business entities in different areas.
Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged
Andhra Pradesh

The "Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged" scheme aims to provide motorized three wheelers to orthopedically challenged persons. This initiative ensures that eligible individuals receive support to enhance their mobility and independence.
Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Final
Andhra Pradesh

The "Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Final" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin students.
Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence
Andhra Pradesh

The "Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence" scheme aims to provide awards to the topper of the recognized and reputed School/ College/ Institute for his/her academic excellence in SSC/ Intermediate or equivalent/ Graduation/ Professional Education Course for the Academic year.
INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Rural)
Andhra Pradesh

"INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Rural)" scheme aims to disburse monthly pensions to the individuals 18 years or above in age and having a disability of 40% or above. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of the district, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
40% Subsidy On Hank Yarn, Dyes & Chemicals Scheme
Andhra Pradesh

The "40% subsidy on Hank Yarn, Dyes & Chemicals Scheme" is a Subsidy Scheme by the Dept. of Handlooms & Textiles, Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. The assistance will be in the form of Grant from the State Govt. The subsidy will be available only on purchases / procurements from NHDC & APCO.
Sanctioning of Tricycles of Orthopedically Challenged
Andhra Pradesh

The "Sanctioning of Tricycles of Orthopedically Challenged" scheme aims to provide tricycles to orthopedically challenged individuals to enhance their mobility and independence. This initiative ensures that eligible individuals receive the necessary support to lead active and self-reliant lives.
Kashyapa Scheme for Food & Shelter
Andhra Pradesh

The "Kashyapa Scheme for Food & Shelter" aims to help poor, orphan children, differently-abled individuals, widows, destitute women separated from their husbands, and elderly Brahmins with financial assistance for meeting their food and shelter expenses. This scheme covers 13 districts of the state.
Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards for Marriages Between Persons with Differently Abled and Normal Persons
Andhra Pradesh

The scheme "Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards..." by the Dept. of Social Welfare, WCD Dept., Govt. of Andhra Pradesh aims to promote inter-abled marriages. It provides ₹1,50,000/- to eligible differently abled persons as a one-time incentive.
Providing Artificial Limbs and Other Appliances to Disabled BOC Workers
Andhra Pradesh

The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board has launched a scheme to provide artificial limbs & other appliances to registered disabled construction workers. The scheme also covers the replacement of limbs every three years based on the workers' needs.
15 Days Skill Up-gradation Training
Andhra Pradesh

The "15 Days Skill Up-gradation Training" scheme aims to provide skill training, safety, and hygiene education for building and other construction workers registered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers
Andhra Pradesh

The "Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers" is a Welfare Scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers LET&F (Labour) Dept. The scheme provides financial assistance to help mitigate the financial burden on the worker's family.
INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Rural)
Andhra Pradesh

"INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Rural)" aims to disburse monthly pensions to old age citizens, both male and female, who are 65 years of age or above and are destitute (with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon). To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family.
INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Urban)
Andhra Pradesh

"INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to widows irrespective of their age. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of a district of Andhra Pradesh, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
Employee Health Scheme
Andhra Pradesh

The Employee Health Scheme (EHS) is a government-run health scheme in Andhra Pradesh, providing cashless treatment at network hospitals for government employees, pensioners, and their families under the Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Healthcare Trust.
Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged
Andhra Pradesh
The "Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged" scheme aims to distribute daisy players to visually challenged students pursuing 9th Class to Degree as per the Action Plan 2017-18.
Bhargava Matching Scheme
Andhra Pradesh

The "Bhargava Matching Scheme" aims to encourage Brahmin Community members who would like to contribute by creating permanent Assets or take up socially relevant activities for the community viz. Andhra Kesari Bhavan (Community Hall), Viswanadha Aarama Kshetram, Old Age Homes, Skill Development, etc
Sanctioning Spectacles to Senior Citizens
Andhra Pradesh

The "Sanctioning Spectacles to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide spectacles to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to improve their vision and enhance their quality of life.
Bharati Scheme for Education - Intermediate or Equivalent
Andhra Pradesh
The scheme aims to encourage Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible poor Brahmin students.
Bharati Scheme for Education - Professional Education Course
Andhra Pradesh

The "Bharati Scheme for Education - Professional Education Course" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin student applicants.
Bharati Scheme for Education - Post-Graduation
Andhra Pradesh

The "Bharati Scheme for Education - Post-Graduation (Any course of 2 Years or more duration, after Graduation (10+2+3) will be considered under this category, i.e., M.Sc, M.Com, M.A., M.Tech, M.D., M.Pharm, MBA, etc.)" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education.
Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas
Andhra Pradesh

The "Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas" aims to provide financial assistance to Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh, who secured admission for any master's degree course overseas in reputed institutions for the year or students pursuing part of their course abroad.
INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Urban)
Andhra Pradesh

"INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to persons with disabilities of 40% or above who are 18 years of age or above. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of Andhra Pradesh, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)
Andhra Pradesh

"INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)" scheme aims to disburse monthly pensions to destitute weavers who are 50 years or above in age. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of the district, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
Bharati Scheme for Education - 6th Class to 10th Class
Andhra Pradesh

"The Bharati Scheme for Education - 6th Class to 10th Class" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin student applicants.
Providing Scholarships to Children of BOC Workers
Andhra Pradesh

The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides scholarships to children of registered workers. The scheme covers up to two children per family. Students of 9th to 12th grade (Intermediate), ITI and Graduation level will receive financial assistance.
Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families
Andhra Pradesh

"Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families" by the Dept. of Handlooms & Textiles, Andhra Pradesh aims to provide wage compensation relief to handloom weaver families. A relief assistance of ₹4,000 per weaver family is provided to compensate for wage loss during the rainy season.
INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Urban)
Andhra Pradesh

"INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to destitute weavers aged 50 years or above. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, and be a resident of Andhra Pradesh. The eligible individuals will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas.
Marriage Gift Scheme (APBOCWWB)
Andhra Pradesh

The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers have introduced the "Marriage Gift Scheme" for registered unmarried women workers & the two daughters of registered construction workers. This welfare initiative aims to provide financial assistance on the occasion of their marriage
Scheme for the Funeral Expenses
Andhra Pradesh

The "Scheme for the Funeral Expenses" by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial support to the family of a registered building and construction worker in the event of their death, whether due to natural causes or an accident.
Farmer Suicide Ex-Gratia
Andhra Pradesh

"Farmer Suicide Ex-Gratia" is a Financial Assistance Scheme by the Agriculture & Cooperation Dept. of the Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹ 7,00,000 to the family members of the deceased farmers/tenant farmers, who commit suicide due to agrarian reasons.
Maternity Benefit Scheme (APBOCWWB)
Andhra Pradesh

The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers have introduced the "Maternity Benefit Scheme" to registered construction workers. The scheme aims to support registered women workers, wives of registered male workers, & their daughters during maternity, reducing the financial strain.
Scheme for Relief to the Un-registered Workers
Andhra Pradesh

The Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board launched a welfare scheme "Scheme for Relief for the Un-registered Workers" to provide the financial assistance to the dependents of unregistered workers who die in accidents at construction sites.
Payment of Ex-Gratia to the Families of Suicidal Weavers
Andhra Pradesh

Launched on 1st June 2004, the scheme "Payment of Ex-Gratia to the Families of Suicidal Weavers" by the Dept. of Handlooms & Textiles, Govt. of Andhra Pradesh, provides ex-gratia of ₹ 1,50,000/- provided to the family / next of kin of the weavers who commit suicide due to weaving-related distress.
Pedalandariki Illu
Andhra Pradesh

"Pedalandariki Illu" is a Housing Scheme by the Revenue Department, Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. 25 lakh House Site Pattas have been announced for distribution to all the eligible beneficiaries residing in Rural & Urban areas on Saturation MoSaturation Mode irrespective of Caste, Creed, or Religion.
Chanakya Swayam Upadhi Scheme for Micro Entrepreneurship - Transport Operator
Andhra Pradesh

The "Chanakya Swayam Upadhi Scheme for Micro Entrepreneurship - Transport Operator" provides subsidies for the purchase of Four-wheelers to unemployed youth for their livelihood. This scheme is applicable for economically weak Brahmins of Andhra Pradesh, who want to settle as transport operators.
Temporary Disability (Hospitalization) Relief Scheme
Andhra Pradesh

The "Temporary Disability (Hospitalization) Relief Scheme" welfare scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers financial assistance to registered construction workers who face temporary disability due to accidents or diseases.
Scheme For Waiver Of Loans To Handloom And Powerloom Sector
Andhra Pradesh

"Scheme for Waiver of Loans to Handloom and Powerloom Sector" redeems the debt accrued by the farmers, Self-Help Groups, Weavers, etc., to the Scheduled Commercial Banks/Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks, and RRBs, through their Branches/Institutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh.
Kalyanamastu Pathakam Scheme - Andhra Pradesh
Andhra Pradesh

The "Kalyanamastu Pathakam Scheme - Andhra Pradesh" aims to encourage girls to marry the boys living in Andhra Pradesh who are getting their livelihood through Vaidikam, a one-time financial assistance of ₹75,000/- will be granted. In order to encourage Vedic culture as well.
Sanctioning of M.C.R. Chappals to Senior Citizens
Andhra Pradesh

The "Sanctioning of M.C.R. Chappals to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide M.C.R. (Micro Cellular Rubber) chappals to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to improve their comfort and mobility.
Sanction of Laptops - Andhra Pradesh
Andhra Pradesh

The "Sanction of Laptops" scheme aims to distribute laptops to visually challenged, hearing impairments, speech impairments, and orthopedic challenges students pursuing professional courses. The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation proposes to procure 200 laptops.
Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged – Speech Impaired
Andhra Pradesh

The "Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged – Speech Impaired" aims to provide touch phones to hearing and speech-impaired individuals who know sign language as per the Action Plan 2017-18. The Assistant Directors, Department for the Welfare of Different, distribute the touch phones.
Medical Assistance (APB&OCWWB)
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Medical Assistance” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
Cash Award (APB&OCWWB)
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Cash Award” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
Chief Minister’s Free Cancer Chemotherapy Scheme
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Chief Minister’s Free Cancer Chemotherapy Scheme” was launched by the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Arunachal Pradesh on 1st August 2017 to tackle the growing incidences of cancer in the state.
Arunachal Pradesh State Stipend Scheme
Arunachal Pradesh
Under this scheme, provide financial support to scheduled tribe (ST) students pursuing higher and technical education through stipends and book grants.
Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Chief Minister’s Yuva Kaushal Yojana (CM YKY)” was launched by the government of Arunachal Pradesh on 1st April 2018 to provide high-end training to the youth across the state to enable them to find jobs in the private sector.
Cluster Nutritional Kitchen Garden Scheme
Arunachal Pradesh

The Cluster Nutritional Kitchen Garden Scheme (CNKGS) is an initiative launched by the government of Arunachal Pradesh to promote self-sufficiency and improve nutritional needs by encouraging the establishment of kitchen gardens.
Advance For Purchase Or Construction Of House (APB&OCWWB)
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Advance for Purchase or Construction of House” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
Arun Pig Development Scheme
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Arun Pig Development Scheme” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Veterinary & Dairy Development, Government of Arunachal Pradesh in the financial year 2019-20 with a focus on pig rearing.
Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana
Arunachal Pradesh

Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana (ANKY) is a scheme launched by the Arunachal Pradesh government to boost the agriculture sector. It provides financial assistance to farmers for various agricultural activities
Atma Nirbhar Matsya Palan Yojana
Arunachal Pradesh
The scheme aims to provide a 45% subsidy with credit linkage for fishery infrastructure to ST individuals, SHGs, and FPOs engaged in aquaculture.
Chief Minister’s Shasakt Kisan Yojana
Arunachal Pradesh

The Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh started the scheme “Chief Minister’s Shasakt Kisan Yojana (CM-SKY)” for uplifting the status of women, marginal and small farmers of the State for self-employment generation & commercialization of Horticulture activities to double their income.
Girl Students Health & Hygiene Scheme
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Girl Students Health & Hygiene Scheme” was announced by the Department of School Education, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh in 2013 for the girl students studying in classes 6-12. The scheme's focus was to retain, maintain hygiene, and continue education throughout the year.
Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana
Arunachal Pradesh

The Government of Arunachal Pradesh has introduced The Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana (CMKRY) with the aim of providing a zero interest crop loan facility to farmers of the state to enable them easy access to formal credit through banking channels.
Atma Nirbhar Plantation Yojana
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme aims to promote self-reliance in the agriculture sector through sustainable plantation activities across the state. Under this scheme, support in the form of plantation assistance and allied resources is provided to individual farmers, Self-Help Groups & Farmer Producer Organizations.
Mid Day Meals Scheme
Arunachal Pradesh
The Mid Day Meals Scheme is a government initiative that provides free meals to school children to improve their nutritional status and encourage school attendance.
Old Age Pension Scheme (APB&OCWWB)
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Old Age Pension Scheme” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
Chief Minister’s Scheme For Wood Carving Artists
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “Chief Minister’s Scheme for Wood Carving Artists” was launched to sustain the rich tradition of work on wood and is encouraged to propagate with the enhancement of aesthetic sensibilities so that it may be at par with international standards.
State Programme For Rehabilitation Of Persons With Disabilities
Arunachal Pradesh

The scheme “State Programme for Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities” is a state sector ongoing scheme implemented for the welfare and providing rehabilitation services to disabled persons of the state under the Person with Disabilities Act 1995.
Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Bunkar Yojana
Arunachal Pradesh
DDUBY is a government initiative in Arunachal Pradesh to provide affordable credit to women weavers, offering an interest subvention of 7% on short-term loans and working capital requirements.
Atma Nirbhar Bagwani Yojana
Arunachal Pradesh

The schemes are part of the Atma Nirbhar program announced during the Budget session held in February this year. A total amount of Rs 120 crores – Rs 60 crores for each scheme has been allocated to the two concerned departments of Agriculture and Horticulture.
Vidya Scheme
Arunachal Pradesh

Vidya scheme under the Education Department, Government of Arunachal Pradesh is a scheme where a girl child who is studying in Class VI is provided with an incentive of Rs. 10,000/- as fixed deposit in SBI in the name of individual girl child till she completes Class – XII.
Financial Assistance For Marriage (APB&OCWWB)
Arunachal Pradesh
